captions.detailed: A seaside harbor bell tower featuring a tall, round timber post topped by a conical shingled cap with a decorative finial. A horizontal wooden crossbeam extends to one side, supported by diagonal wooden braces. An iron-colored bell with a flared skirt hangs from a mounting cleat at the end of the crossbeam, designed to swing freely about a horizontal revolute axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a seaside harbor bell tower with a round timber post, a conical shingled cap, and a single iron bell. The bell should hang from a horizontal crossbeam extending from the post and be capable of swinging on a horizontal revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main post using a cylinder primitive and the crossbeam using a box primitive. Create the conical shingled cap by stacking progressively smaller cones or cylinders, and add diagonal support braces using angled box extrusions. Model the bell by revolving a custom 2D profile or combining a cylinder and a lofted shape, then define a revolute joint on the horizontal axis connecting the bell to the crossbeam.
